topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: I step outside, the morning air crisp and unsettling. My eyes dart to the driveway, the space where my car should be, now disturbingly empty. A towing ticket lies on the ground, crumpled, mocking. I read the fine print, my hands trembling. Regulations, fines, a mysterious note about unauthorized parking. This is my home, my driveway. My mind races, trying to piece together how this could happen, searching for any mistake I might have overlooked. The street is quiet, neighbors not yet awake. I feel exposed, alone, the world suddenly unpredictable.
